# Effects

<!-- Translation of docs/efectos.md (generated by tools/build-efectos.mjs). build-efectos.mjs --comprobar fails if it stops linking the same demos and recipes. -->
[← Back to README](../README.md)

Senzu ships a catalog of front-end effects with a recipe per stack (Astro, Next/React, Vue/Inertia). You ask for them in
plain language («add a parallax», «make the logo fall and break the screen») or with `/effect`, and the agent opens ONLY
the recipe for that effect. All of them have a «reduce motion» version and a decided mobile cost.

## Working demos

Self-contained HTML files: they open with a double click and are the base the agent adapts to the project.

### Intro with a falling object and a broken screen

An object falls, hits the screen, the screen cracks and the glass breaks into pieces that fall away and reveal the website. Also works as a loader that cracks while loading.

- **Demo:** [`intro-rotura.html`](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/demos/intro-rotura.html)
- **Recipe:** [fisica-impacto.md §intro o loader con caída y pantalla rota](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/fisica-impacto.md#intro-o-loader-con-caída-y-pantalla-rota)
- **Dependencies:** none
- **Interaction:** «Skip intro» button and Escape
- **With «reduce motion»:** No intro
- **On mobile:** Fewer pieces and a smaller object
- **Try it:** `?intro=1` (forces it even if it was already seen in the session) · `?intro=1&modo=loader` (loader mode: the cracks advance with the loading and it breaks when done)

### Object that falls on top of everything

A chosen object falls over the website, collides with the real blocks, rests on the target and can be grabbed and thrown.

- **Demo:** [`objeto-cae.html`](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/demos/objeto-cae.html)
- **Recipe:** [fisica-impacto.md §objeto que cae encima de todo](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/fisica-impacto.md#objeto-que-cae-encima-de-todo)
- **Dependencies:** matter-js 0.20.0 (MIT; jsdelivr CDN, when the target comes into view)
- **Interaction:** Drag and throw the object
- **With «reduce motion»:** Appears already resting, without loading the engine
- **On mobile:** Its own target (data-fisica-destino-movil): the blocks stack up

### The page collapses

With a button, the page elements fall with gravity and pile up; they can be dragged and thrown, and Escape puts them back in place.

- **Demo:** [`pagina-desmorona.html`](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/demos/pagina-desmorona.html)
- **Recipe:** [fisica-impacto.md §la página se desmorona](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/fisica-impacto.md#la-página-se-desmorona)
- **Dependencies:** matter-js 0.20.0 (MIT; jsdelivr CDN, when the button is pressed)
- **Interaction:** «Activate gravity» button, drag, Escape or «Rebuild»
- **With «reduce motion»:** No gravity button
- **On mobile:** The same, with the screen edges as walls

### The website breaks like glass

The page looks normal; a click or a falling object hits it, it cracks and splits into pieces that are the website itself (real text, no screenshots) and fall spinning in 3D. Behind it appears whatever you choose.

- **Demo:** [`web-rota.html`](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/demos/web-rota.html)
- **Recipe:** [fisica-impacto.md §la web se rompe como un cristal](../core/skills-plugin/front-activation/references/recipes/fisica-impacto.md#la-web-se-rompe-como-un-cristal)
- **Dependencies:** none
- **Interaction:** «Break the website» button (breaks where you click), Escape skips it, «Back» rebuilds it
- **With «reduce motion»:** Fade to what is behind, no breaking
- **On mobile:** Fewer pieces and a shorter shake
- **Try it:** `?auto=1` (an object falls after 0.8 s and breaks the website (intro mode))

## Rules when applying any effect

- `prefers-reduced-motion` is mandatory: implement the fallback from the Reduced-motion column with `gsap.matchMedia()` (see `gsap-scrolltrigger → references/es/performance-a11y.md` §6) or a CSS media query.
- Animate only `transform` and `opacity`; no `top/left/width/height/filter` on scroll (they cause layout/paint on every frame).
- No scroll-jacking or pin on pages or sections with forms, checkout or long reading content.
- Mobile budget: at most one High-cost effect per page; on mobile, degrade or disable High-cost effects (`ScrollTrigger.matchMedia` / touch pointer detection).
- Cleanup on unmount: `gsap.context()` + `revert()`, `ScrollTrigger.kill()`, `lenis.destroy()`, `effect.destroy()` (Vanta/Pixi/Three) in the component unmount.
